description: Normalizes 27 EU member states + Northern Ireland (XI) B2B VAT IDs (auto-converting Greece GR -> EL) and checks cross-border reverse-charge format eligibility locally (or simulates VIES states when demo: true).

demo.description: Required when using simulated viesMode values (VALID, INVALID, MS_UNAVAILABLE, GLOBAL_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQ) in local mode.

supplyType.description: Cross-border transaction supply category: 'GOODS' (Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 138(1) intra-Community supply, default; permitted for Northern Ireland XI under Windsor Framework) or 'SERVICES' (Directive 2006/112/EC Art. 196 B2B reverse charge; excluded from EU VIES for Northern Ireland XI).

name: revclamp_validate_eu_vat_vies
